title: Session Export
description: A completed training session exported by AccelerometerLifting for LLM analysis.

schemaVersion.description: 1.1: velocityLoss_pct is best-to-LAST rep; unmeasured phases are null rather than 0; tempo compliance scores movement digits only; repMetricsComplete reports per-rep coverage.

hrvRmssd_ms.description: Session-wide HRV (RMSSD, ms) computed from R-R intervals with artifact rejection.

load_lb.description: Same load in pounds for convenience; load_kg is canonical.

plannedLoad_kg.description: Present when the set deviated from or followed a plan.

scoredPhases.description: Which phases were scored. Pauses are measured and reported but never scored.

actualEccConRatio.description: Measured eccentric:concentric contrast. Diagnostic, not a corrected score: the measurement bias is multiplicative.

repMetrics.description: Per-rep detail; present only in detailed exports.

voiceCues.description: Spoken voice cues during the set ('Down', '3', 'Up', 'Rep 4', 'Time'...), stamped in epoch ms on the same clock as the raw IMU/HR streams so they can be cross-referenced with accelerometer data. Detailed export only.

t_ms.description: Epoch milliseconds when the cue was spoken.

peakPower_w.description: Best instantaneous concentric (drive) power across the set, watts.

meanConPower_w.description: Mean of per-rep average concentric power, watts.

duration_s.description: Actual hold/carry seconds for timed sets.

side.description: Unilateral sets: which side was trained.

rpe.description: Lifter-reported RPE, entered on the rest screen.

failed.description: True when the lifter marked the set as failed.

warmup.description: True for warm-up sets; these carry no RPE and should be excluded from effort/fatigue analysis.

repsManual.description: True when reps were entered or corrected manually rather than sensor-counted.

repMetricsComplete.description: False when the sensor segmenter resolved a different number of reps than the set records — fewer, or more, than the lifter or the voice guide counted. Everything derived from the segmented reps is then drawn from a sample of the set rather than from the set: velocityLoss_pct, tempoCompliance, summary, and the repMetrics array where one is present. Read false as a caveat on those figures whether or not per-rep detail was requested. True is weaker than it looks: when repsManual is false the recorded count IS the segmenter's count, so the two agree by construction and this says nothing independent. Absent means the segmenter resolved no reps at all, which is a third state and not a synonym for false — nothing derived from reps is published either, so there is no figure left to qualify.

peakPower_w.description: Peak instantaneous power during this rep's concentric, watts.

meanConPower_w.description: Average power over the concentric phase of this rep, watts.
